steps.en: The portal lists the notices that can be furnished
steps.id: Portal menampilkan daftar notice yang bisa di-furnish

steps.en: The user ticks the notices to furnish
steps.id: User mencentang notice yang mau di-furnish
steps.why_en: Ticked notices are lost when the user moves to another page of the list.
steps.why_id: Centang notice hilang kalau user pindah ke halaman lain di daftar.

steps.en: Proceed opens the particulars form with the chosen notices shown
steps.id: Tombol lanjut membuka form data dengan notice terpilih tampil

steps.en: The same details are applied to every selected notice
steps.id: Data yang sama dipakai untuk semua notice terpilih
